_how_to_use: Each entry below adds an 'Our Take' paragraph to that property's page, written by Sheena and Michael. The key is the property's page name (the part of the web address after /properties/, without .html). To add one, copy an existing line, change the page name and the text, and commit. To remove one, delete its line. Changes go live on the next daily update, or straight away if you run the Update Listings workflow. Keep the quote marks and the comma at the end of each line.
mirador-del-valle-land-lots-from-us70m2-: Mirador del Valle is one of the most affordable ways we know to own titled land on the North Coast. Lots start at around 200 m² and sit right on the Imbert to Puerto Plata highway, so getting in and out is easy. It suits buyers planning a modest home, a long-term land hold, or a first step into the market on a small budget. The reservation deposit is low and there's a payment plan, but as with any lot purchase, have your attorney confirm the individual lot's title and survey before you pay the balance.
panorama-village-sosua-build-your-dream-: Panorama Village is where we send buyers who want ocean views and space but don't want to be in the middle of town. The lots are larger than most in Sosúa, the community is gated, and you can either pick one of the ready-designed home models or build your own. Budget for construction on top of the lot price and the monthly HOA, and plan on a timeline of a year or more for a custom build. If a quiet hillside home with a view is the goal, this is one of the better starting points around Sosúa.
plaza-del-sol-1bedroom-side-by-side-unit: This is the lower-priced of the two side-by-side Plaza del Sol units, and the pair is what makes it interesting. Buy one as a walkable base in El Batey, or buy both and you have two rentable one-bedroom units next to each other, which is handy for investors or for family visiting at the same time. You're a short walk to Sosúa Beach, restaurants and supermarkets, so a car is optional. At this price it's one of the most accessible ways into central Sosúa. Ask us for the building's monthly fees and rental rules before you decide.
plaza-del-sol-1bedroom-walk-to-sosua-bea: If you want to walk everywhere, El Batey is the part of Sosúa to be in, and Plaza del Sol puts you in the middle of it. Beach, restaurants, banks and supermarkets are all a short stroll away, and the complex has a pool and jacuzzi. A one-level, one-bedroom unit like this works well as a lock-and-leave vacation home or a simple rental. The identical unit next door is also for sale if you'd like two. It's a good fit for first-time buyers and anyone who'd rather not depend on a car.
centrally-located-2-bedroom-penthouse-in: Two bedrooms, three bathrooms and a two-level penthouse layout for $160,000 in the centre of El Batey is hard to find. You can walk to Sosúa Beach, the supermarkets and the restaurant strip, and the extra bathroom makes it easy to share with guests or rent by the room. The seller offers owner financing with 50% down, which helps if you'd rather not tie up the full amount at once. It's well suited to a buyer who wants an affordable town base or a rental they can also use themselves.
1br-furnished-apartment-sosua-ocean-vill: This is one of the more affordable ways into Sosúa Ocean Village, one of the best-known gated communities on the coast. The apartment is furnished, has its own parking space, and the monthly HOA covers 24/7 security, pool and grounds maintenance, and a water allowance. The seller is also offering financing with 50% down. It's a sensible option for someone who wants resort-style amenities and security without the cost and upkeep of a villa, whether that's a vacation home or a rental.
turnkey-1-bedroom-apartment-with-rooftop: Costambar is a gated beach community just west of Puerto Plata city, and this apartment is already set up and operating as a vacation rental, so a buyer isn't starting from zero. At 121 m² it's large for a one-bedroom, and the private rooftop terrace with jacuzzi is what guests remember. Ask us for the actual booking history rather than relying on projections. It suits an investor who wants something rent-ready near Puerto Plata, or a buyer who wants a beach base with more space than a typical one-bedroom.
beautiful-3-bedroom-townhome-in-pueblo-e: La Mulata is a quiet, established neighbourhood a few minutes from central Sosúa, and this townhome gives you three bedrooms, three bathrooms and a private pool for $245,000, which is strong value for that much space. There's no HOA fee, it's furnished, and the seller will consider owner financing with 50% down. It works for a family moving down full time, a vacation home with room for guests, or a rental. Message us and we'll walk you through it in person or on video.
fully-furnished-2-bedroom-condo-in-resid: Residencial Hispaniola is one of Sosúa's most accessible gated communities, and this condo was completed in 2024 and has never been rented. It comes fully furnished, with a backup generator and 24-hour security, so it's ready to use from day one. It's one of only two units with this floor plan in the building. The seller is open to financing with 50% down. It suits buyers who want something new and low-maintenance in a secure community without paying villa prices.
el-paraiso-eco-luxury-3-bedroom-villa-wi: El Paraiso is for buyers who want quiet and greenery more than nightlife. It's in a gated hillside community above Sosúa with mountain views, and the layout includes two independent studios alongside the main bedrooms, which is useful if you want guest space or a small rental income on the side. It's pet-friendly and has a private pool. Owner financing is available. You'll want a car here, but you're still a short drive from Sosúa's beaches and shops.
1-bedroom-apartment-for-sale-in-sosua-oc: At almost 140 m² over two levels, this is a big one-bedroom, more like a small house than a typical condo. It's in Sosúa Ocean Village, so you get the gated security, shared pool and the community amenities, with the HOA covering security, grounds and a water allowance. Financing is available over seven years with 50% down. It's a good match for a couple who want plenty of room and a secure lock-and-leave home, or an investor looking at longer stays.
2-bedroom-villa-private-pool-near-sosua-: Casa Sueño is a two-level villa with its own pool on a 750 m² lot, in a gated community between Sosúa and Cabarete. That location is handy: you're a short drive to both towns' beaches and restaurants without living in either. Both bedrooms open onto private terraces, and the HOA covers the community's shared upkeep and security. It suits a couple who want a private villa with a pool rather than an apartment, as a full-time home or a vacation property.
furnished-2-bed-second-floor-apartment-1: Being 150 metres from Playa Chiquita, about a one-minute walk, is the big draw here. This is the upstairs unit in a small four-unit complex, so it's quieter than a large building, and the property is raised above ground level to protect against flooding. It comes furnished, with a shared pool and a backup generator. It suits buyers who want to be close to the beach in a calm residential area, whether for their own use or as a vacation rental. The ground-floor unit is also available.
modern-3-bed-minimalist-home-with-pool-r: Torre Alta is one of Puerto Plata's established gated neighbourhoods, and this modern home gives you three bedrooms, a pool and a 90 m² rooftop terrace on a clean title. Puerto Plata is the region's main city, with the hospital, banks, schools and big supermarkets close by, so this works well for a family or anyone living here full time who wants city convenience. The seller is open to financing part of the price. If being near the beach matters most, Sosúa or Cabarete may suit you better, but for everyday living this is a strong option.
move-in-ready-2br-near-playa-chiquita-so: This is the ground-floor twin of the Playa Chiquita apartment upstairs: same four-unit complex, about a minute's walk to the beach, and raised above grade to protect against flooding. Ground floor suits anyone who'd rather skip the stairs, and it comes with a pool, generator and Starlink internet already in place, which matters for remote workers. It's move-in ready and furnished, so it can be used or rented straight away. If you prefer an upper floor, ask us about the second-floor unit.
last-available-3-bedroom-oceanview-condo: This is the final three-bedroom unit in a modern building in Costambar, a gated beach community just outside Puerto Plata. You get 176 m², four bathrooms, an elevator and ocean views, and the beach is about two minutes away. It's good value per square metre compared with similar space in Sosúa or Cabarete. It suits families or buyers who want a full-size condo near the beach with Puerto Plata city's services close at hand.
ocean-view-villa-in-gated-lomas-mironas-: Ocean views from nearly every room, in a gated community, at $349,000, is the reason to look at this one. Each bedroom has its own terrace, there's a wraparound ocean-view balcony and a separate guest studio, and it comes furnished. The HOA is modest. It's a good fit for a retirement move, a second home, or a rental that also works for your own visits. You'll want a car, but central Sosúa is a short drive away.
new-construction-3-bedroom-villa-el-choc: Casa Tikva is a small development of 15 contemporary villas in El Choco, and this Model A is the entry point. You get three bedrooms, a private pool, a two-car garage and 3-metre ceilings, with smart-home and solar-ready wiring built in. El Choco is a quieter, greener area in the hills just outside Sosúa, still only minutes from beaches and schools. As with any new build, ask about the payment schedule, completion date and warranty, and we'll help you compare the three models.
a-3724: Model B at Casa Tikva steps up to 290 m², with an extra bathroom over Model A, and keeps the same private pool, two-car garage and modern specification. It's a good middle option for buyers who want room for guests or a home office without moving up to four bedrooms. El Choco gives you a quieter setting just outside Sosúa. New-construction buyers should review the developer's payment plan, delivery timeline and finishing package with their attorney. We can arrange a site visit to see the project in person.
fully-furnished-3-bedroom-villa-sosua-oc: Villas Marinas is one of the most popular sections of Sosúa Ocean Village, and this furnished three-bedroom villa sits on a good-sized 468 m² lot with a rooftop terrace. You get the full community package, including security, the clubhouse, sports courts and beach access, without the upkeep of a large estate. The seller offers financing with 50% down over up to three years. It's an easy choice for a family vacation home or a rental that's ready to go.
villa-sojuleg-4br-luxury-designer-villa-: Villa Sojuleg is a designer villa in Plantation by Star Hills, a gated community on the Puerto Plata side of the coast. Every one of the four bedrooms has its own bathroom, and the finishes are a clear step above standard: quartz counters, a floating glass staircase and imported porcelain tile. At $487,500 for 325 m², it's competitive against similar new builds in Sosúa. It suits a family wanting a modern, high-spec home close to Puerto Plata's services.
move-in-ready-villa-with-private-pool-mo: Villa Agua Marina 31A is move-in ready, furnished, with a private pool, generator and mountain views, on an 839 m² lot in a gated community near Sosúa. It's two bedrooms today, but the large upstairs balcony could become a third bedroom or a home office with modest work, which adds future value. It suits a couple who want a finished villa now with the option to grow later, or a buyer who wants a low-effort vacation home.
sosua-ocean-village-penthouse-two-level-: This top-floor penthouse in Sosúa Ocean Village has a 40 m² sunset terrace and a clever layout: the main two-bedroom home on one level, and a separate studio with its own kitchenette upstairs that you can use as a guest suite, office or rental. That gives you villa-sized living with condo-style upkeep, plus SOV's beach club, gym and courts. It suits buyers who want space, views and some income potential without maintaining a house.
4-bed-sosua-villa-with-pool-cathedral-ce: This Casa Linda villa does two jobs: a four-bedroom family home with a pool and cathedral ceilings, plus a separate apartment you can rent out to offset costs. The lot is over 1,000 m², which is generous for the community, and you have Casa Linda's security, tennis courts, mini-golf and restaurant inside the gates. It's about five minutes to Sosúa's main beach and the international school. It suits families who want space and some rental income.
new-construction-4-bedroom-villa-with-po: Model C is the largest villa at Casa Tikva, with four bedrooms and 330 m² of living space, for families who need the extra room. It keeps the development's private pool, two-car garage and smart-home-ready design. Buying new in a small 15-villa project means newer infrastructure and a chance to choose finishes, but review the developer's payment plan and delivery terms carefully. We can help you compare all three Casa Tikva models side by side.
custom-built-5-bedroom-estate-up-in-the-: This home is built for privacy. It's a custom-built home on a 2,000 m² gated lot in the hills of El Choco, about a year and a half old and owned only by the people who built it. With a detached guest suite you have five bedrooms in total, and the terraces add a lot of extra living space. Mountain views, a quiet setting and room to spread out are the draw. It's a strong fit for a family relocating full time, or anyone who wants land and privacy without giving up easy access to Sosúa.
5-bedroom-villa-for-sale-in-casa-linda-s: The layout is what sets this Casa Linda villa apart. Each of the five bedrooms has its own entrance, and there's an independent apartment, so you can rent the whole house, split it into smaller units, or live in part and rent the rest. It sits on a large 1,315 m² lot inside one of Sosúa's most established gated communities, with the clubhouse, pools and 24-hour security. It suits investors who want flexible rental income or large families.
private-3-bedroom-villa-with-pool-guest-: This three-bedroom villa is built for indoor-outdoor living, with a guest suite that gives visitors their own space and a good-sized pool and garden. It's on a 750 m² lot in a gated community with sports courts, a short drive from both Sosúa and Cabarete. The HOA covers the community's security and shared upkeep. It suits a couple or family who host friends often, or anyone who wants a private, finished home with room to entertain.
private-3-bedroom-villa-on-a-1068-m-lot-: Villa La Paz is a single-level home, which is less common here and a real plus for retirees or anyone who'd rather skip stairs. The lot is over 1,000 m², so there's room to add a casita or extra rooms later, and the pool terrace looks out over the valley. It's in a gated community with 24-hour security and comes furnished. It suits buyers who want space, privacy and easy one-floor living.
modern-3-bedroom-villa-with-private-pool: Villa 64-A is a new-construction villa inside Sosúa Ocean Village, so you get a modern home with a private pool and 3.5 bathrooms while keeping the community's gated security, beach club, gym and courts. New villas inside SOV don't come up often. It suits buyers who want new rather than resale, in an established community where the amenities already exist. Ask us about the build stage, delivery timing and what's included.
4-bedroom-villa-sea-horse-ranch-pool-jac: Sea Horse Ranch is one of the North Coast's original gated beachfront communities, and this villa gives you 540 m² of space on a 2,750 m² elevated lot, which is a lot of home for the money. It was built in 2001, so expect to budget for some updating, but the size, lot and community make that worthwhile for the right buyer. It suits someone who wants to personalise a large villa in an established, secure community between Sosúa and Cabarete.
fully-furnished-3-bedroom-villa-with-ove: This furnished Villas Marinas home is three rows back from the ocean in Sosúa Ocean Village, with sea, mountain and sunset views. Every bedroom has its own en-suite and walk-in closet, and the oversized pool is a highlight for families and rental guests alike. Owner financing is available. It suits buyers who want a turnkey luxury villa inside SOV, either as a vacation home or a higher-end rental.
4br-luxury-villa-w-casita-sosua-ocean-vi: This nearly finished luxury villa sits on a large 1,200 m² lot in Sosúa Ocean Village, close to Playa Laguna and Playa Chiquita, and adds a separate casita for guests or staff. Because it isn't fully complete, a buyer still has room to choose some of the finishes. Five covered terraces and a double-height living room give it real presence. It suits buyers looking at the top end of SOV who'd like a say in the final touches.
villa-coral-vista-ocean-village-deluxe-3: Ocean Village Deluxe is the premium section of Sosúa Ocean Village, and this second-line villa has 420 m² of living space on a 1,157 m² lot, with every bedroom en-suite. The rooftop terrace and balconies give you the ocean view, and you're steps from the community's beach and clubhouse. Note that the HOA is higher than in standard SOV sections, which reflects the level of service. It suits buyers who want space, privacy and the full resort lifestyle.
second-line-villa-ocean-village-deluxe-c: This is the smaller of the two second-line villas we have in Ocean Village Deluxe, at 194 m² on a large 1,200 m² lot, and it's close to the community amenities. You get ocean views from the rooftop terrace, en-suite bedrooms and a private pool. The big lot leaves room to expand later. It suits buyers who value location within SOV Deluxe and land over a larger house today.
la-colina-gated-development-opportunity-: La Colina is for builders and investors, not home buyers. It's a partly completed gated community in the hills of El Choco with titled, subdivided lots, completed homes, presold inventory and infrastructure already in place, which takes much of the early-stage risk out of a development project. A buyer would need a development team ready to finish it. If that's you, we can share the full package and arrange a site visit.
oceanfront-estate-on-126-acres-playa-chi: Direct oceanfront land of this size is rare around Sosúa. This estate sits on 1.26 acres at Playa Chiquita, with a main residence and a separate three-bedroom casita for nine bedrooms in total. That makes it suit large or multi-generational families, a boutique rental operation, or a buyer who simply wants the land and the shoreline. Owner financing is available. We'd recommend an early visit and an independent inspection given the scale of the property.
